title: Guandan
tagline: Two decks. Four seats. One partnership climb.
taglineZh: 两副牌，四个人，搭档一起升级。
factsZh: 单人 · 同屏 · 局域网

lines.en: Two decks. One hundred and eight cards. Four seats.
lines.zh: 两副牌，一百零八张，四个座位。

lines.en: The level card rules the table. The heart level card is wild.
lines.zh: 级牌压场，红桃级牌是配牌。

lines.en: Singles, pairs, straights, consecutive pairs and triples, bombs and the joker bomb.
lines.zh: 单张、对子、顺子、钢板、炸弹，还有天王炸。

lines.en: Three passes reset the trick. First and second gain three levels.
lines.zh: 三家过牌重置，包揽第一第二升三级。

lines.en: Tribute, anti-tribute, and a match that ends at A.
lines.zh: 进贡、抗贡，一路打到 A。

lines.en: Four computer levels, private hot-seat, and three guests on your network.
lines.zh: 四档电脑、同屏热座，还能在同一网络里坐满四位。
